vocabulary.definition: a condition in which the body's immune system mistakenly attacks and destroys healthy body tissue
vocabulary.example: Autoimmunity can lead to diseases like Type 1 diabetes and lupus.

vocabulary.definition: large molecules composed of amino acids that perform various functions in the body
vocabulary.example: Proteins are essential for the growth and repair of tissues in the body.

vocabulary.definition: small proteins that are important in cell signaling, especially in the immune responses
vocabulary.example: During an infection, cytokines are released to signal the immune system to respond.

vocabulary.definition: a firm, rubbery tissue that cushions bones at joints and provides structure to the nose, ears, and other parts of the body
vocabulary.example: Damage to the cartilage in the knee can lead to joint pain and stiffness.

vocabulary.definition: related to genes or heredity, the study of how traits are passed down from parents to offspring
vocabulary.example: Certain diseases have a genetic component, meaning they can be inherited from family members.

vocabulary.definition: wicked, villainous, or criminal in nature
vocabulary.example: Some hackers have nefarious intentions, seeking to steal personal information for malicious purposes.
